# Data protection impact assessment: [title]

Copy this page and fill it in. It matches the screens in the Data Protection
tool, so you can paste the answers in. It is not legal advice. Ask your own
data protection adviser to check it.

- **Prepared by:** [name]
- **Date:** [1 April 2027]
- **Processing activities covered:** [names from your records of processing]
- **Review on:** [date]

## 1. What you plan to do

Describe the processing in plain words: what data, whose, where it comes from,
who sees it and how long you keep it. Example: "We will collect the contact
details and bank details of people who win a grant, to pay them."

## 2. Screening questions

Answer Yes, No or Not sure.

| Question | Answer |
| --- | --- |
| Does it use special category or criminal offence data on a large scale? | |
| Does it involve children or other vulnerable people? | |
| Does it monitor people systematically, such as tracking where they are or what they do? | |
| Does it profile people or make automated decisions about them? | |
| Does it use new technology? | |
| Does it match or combine data from different sources? | |
| Does it collect data in a way people may not expect or cannot easily avoid? | |
| Could it stop people getting a grant or another service? | |

## 3. Why the processing is needed

Say what you are trying to achieve, which lawful basis applies, and why a less
intrusive way would not work.

## 4. Risks to people

| Risk | How likely (Remote, Possible, Probable) | How severe (Minimal, Significant, Severe) | How you will reduce it |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| | | | |

## 5. Advice

Record the advice of your data protection officer, if you have one, and what
you did with it.

## 6. Decision

Say whether you will go ahead, change the plan or stop. Record who signed off,
and the date to review it.
